title: oracle-interval: code, results and figures for 'Waiting, judgement, and responsibility: lessons from divination for human oversight of irreversible decisions'
description: Simulation code, result tables (CSV, one per figure or table) and figures for the article by Junzhe Shi, Yuan Gan, Shengyu Tao, Shumo Wang and Yuhan Hao. The repository contains a sequential-decision model with four decision types, an imposed wait, a random verdict and a hand-off from an AI agent; fixed random seeds and a script (reproduce.sh) regenerate every number and figure. No human-participant, survey or personal data are included.
